annotations.title: Request a change from an operator

description: File a change request (goal, acceptance, optional constraints) as a ticket to one operator that accepts tickets from agents. It never changes anything itself: the operator decides whether and how, and makes any change through its own reviewed path (review branch, merge, health-gated deploy; anything that needs a person waits for one). Follow it with get_operator_ticket. Needs operators:instruct (an owner's or admin's key).

acceptance.description: How the operator (and you) can tell it is done.

client_ticket_id.description: Your own id for this request (8-64 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ -). Retrying with the same id and the same content returns the first ticket instead of filing a second one.

constraints.description: What must not change or happen.

name: request_operator_change
title: Request a change from an operator
